executiveAssessment.text: Waterstone Resort & Marina currently shows AI Consideration of 51.3% and Scenario Presence of 73.1%, with Reality Coverage at 38.9%. Strongest governed signal: Strong visibility for Couples / Romantic Stay. Primary constraint: Not appearing consistently in AI answers. Versus the prior published run (2026-09-02), material headline movement is AI Consideration 0.0 pp and Scenario Presence 0.0 pp. Independent Positioning shows #4 of 6 with Portfolio AI Presence 50.0%. Overall Core performance is mixed: some indicators are competitive while others still show material gaps. Management should protect the stronger signals while closing the specific gaps that are already visible in evidence.

positiveSignal.title: Positive Signal
positiveSignal.body: For Couples / Romantic Stay searches, Waterstone Resort & Marina appeared in 72.2% of AI answers, compared with 12.3% for the comparable hotels used in this analysis. That means the hotel was surfaced about 5.9 times as often as the comparable hotels used in this analysis. In practical terms, this is the area where the hotel is showing its clearest visibility advantage versus similar hotels.

secondaryCallout.title: Performance Risk
secondaryCallout.body: The hotel appeared in at least one AI answer for 73.1% of the traveler needs we tested, but across all individual AI answers it appeared 51.3% of the time. In practical terms, AI recognizes the hotel as relevant for many types of trips, but a traveler will not consistently see it among the hotel options surfaced.
